changelog: Your private Mind can now sit beside the composer — and only there. vibe_mind appears when a private 0600 credential exists on this machine, consults your own edge Mind over your private network, and shows one sourced offer or stays silent. It never sends, never touches slashvibe.dev, and ordinary messaging is unchanged and immediate.
features: vibe_mind: a private pre-send thinking pass — one sourced offer or silence; nothing is sent without your explicit approval
The tool exists only when ~/.vibe/<identity>/mind/runtime-token is a private (0600) regular file; without it, vibe_mind does not appear in tools/list
The Mind is consulted directly over your private Tailnet — no request ever transits slashvibe.dev
Mind consultations bypass prompt retention and the ambient footer entirely (tool-privacy policy, behaviorally tested)
An offer without a concrete source, or a refused credential, is reported honestly — silence and unavailable are different words
vibe_dm and vibe_reply are untouched: exact user-approved prose sends immediately, Mind or no Mind
